title: The Suite Retreats with Large Lounge Space
description:
Discover the charm of this one-of-a-kind property, boasting over 4,700 sq.ft. on 1.3 acres. Nestled in the heart of Historic Nolensville, you'll find yourself just a stone's throw away from charming shops, cozy coffee spots, and delectable restaurants.
